name: Welspun Specialty Solutions Limited
summary: Welspun Specialty Solutions Limited manufactures and sells steel and steel products in India and internationally. The company offers alloy, stainless, and Ni-alloy steel products; cast blooms and ingots; round bars and corner squares; peeled and polished bright bars; and heat treated products, such as annealed, spheroidised annealed, normalized, and soft annealed. It also provides billets, black bars, tubes, pipes, and hollow profiles of tube or pipe fittings; hot and cold-rolled steel products; and tube and tube fittings of steel.
